vetSays.line: 🛡️ Vy, Layla, Esperanza and Stan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Vy, Layla, Esperanza are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
💥 The Scarred The Anaconda Empress SNAPS! No warning. There never is.
Scarred The Anaconda Empress hits you for 9.
Vy SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. The The Scarred The Anaconda Empress freezes. (stunned)
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Anaconda Empress is still frozen from your scream.
Vy strikes the Scarred The Anaconda Empress.
Scarred The Anaconda Empress hits you for 7.
The Scarred The Anaconda Empress falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Anaconda Empress!
📺 You brought down Scarred The Anaconda Empress. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred The Anaconda Empress.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Layla just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vy, Layla, Jorge, Luis and Tashi met them at the door — 5 put down. Vy, Layla, Jorge, Luis, Tashi are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Tashi was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Valeria taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Valeria passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred The Loud Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Loud Beast!
🛡️ Vasyl and Miguel met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Vasyl is hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Eamon — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Eamon chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🛡️ Vasyl, Valeria and Miguel met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Vasyl, Valeria, Miguel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Valeria and Miguel met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Valeria, Miguel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vasyl and Jenny met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jenny is hurt.
